Japanese singer. At the age of 15, Aimer suddenly lost her voice due to overuse of her throat by singing, but a few years later she got a unique husky and sweet singing voice.
Aimer made her major debut with single “Rokutosei no yoru” in 2011. Later on in September 2016, she released her 4th album “daydream" which includes her representative song “Chouchou Musubi” and the album topped the iTunes album chart in Japan. In 2019, she released her 16th single “I beg you / hanabiratachinomarch / Sailing” which topped the weekly single Oricon chart for the first time in her career.
Her song ‘Zankyosanka’ for the worldwide popular anime “Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba” as its season 2 opening theme became a global hit soon after release in 2022. The song holds at #1 for the seventh week in a row on the Billboard Japan’s “JAPAN HOT 100” and set an all-time record in Billboard JAPAN history. It also topped Billboard Japan’s 2022 year-end Japan Hot 100, the comprehensive song chart that includes CD sales, streaming, and video views.
Aimer won the "64th Japan Record Award Special Award" at the end of 2022 and made her first appearance at the 73rd NHK Kohaku Uta Gassen singing ‘Zankyosanka’. The worldwide hit song was included in her 7th studio album titled “Open α Door” that came out on July 26th, 2023.

data.description:
Aki Toyosaki (豊崎 愛生, Toyosaki Aki, born 28 October 1986) is a Japanese actress and singer. She had her first major voice acting roles in 2007, voicing Amuro Ninagawa in Kenkō Zenrakei Suieibu Umishō and Su in Shugo Chara!. She was named "Best New Actress" at the 4th Seiyu Awards in 2010 for her role as Yui Hirasawa in K-On! and Kana Nakamachi in Kanamemo, and received the "Best Lead Actress" and "Best Personality" awards at the 5th Seiyu Awards in 2011.

Her career as a musician began with her performance of the opening and ending themes of the anime series K-On! in April 2009. In the same month, she and three other voice actresses debuted as the musical group Sphere with their single "Future Stream". Later, K-On!'s ending theme was given Animation Kobe's "Best Song" award. She released her first solo single "love your life" in October 2009, and has since released two albums and eleven singles that have placed in the top 20 of Oricon's weekly charts. She was awarded "Best Musical Performance" at the 4th Seiyu Awards for her performance on the K-On! mini-album Hōkago Tea Time with four other actresses.
data.name: Aki Toyosaki

data.description:
ALI is a boundary-pushing project centered around its vocalist LEO, a multicultural artist whose roots span Japan, Spain, the UK, and the Philippines. Based in Shibuya, Tokyo, the group lives by the motto “Long Live Music,” blending the rhythms of funk, soul, jazz, and Latin music with the raw energy of hip-hop, rock, and ska to create a truly genre-crossing sound.

They first made waves with their independently released 2019 single "Wild Side," which served as the opening theme for the anime BEASTARS. Following this release, they skyrocketed to mainstream success with their first major-label track “LOST IN PARADISE feat. AKLO,” which was chosen to be the ending theme for the global hit anime JUJUTSU KAISEN. MLB star Shohei Ohtani used the song as his walk-up song during his time with the Los Angeles Angels, shining even more light on the band and their work.

In 2022, ALI contributed “NEVER SAY GOODBYE feat. Mummy-D” as the opening theme for the anime Golden Kamuy, and in 2024, their songs “Professionalism feat. Hannya” and “BEYOND feat. MaRI” were used as opening and ending themes for the anime The Fable. Most recently, in 2025, their song “CASANOVA POSSE” was chosen as the opening for the first part of the fourth season of the anime Dr. STONE.In 2026, Awich × ALI “Golden Horizon” was chosen as the theme song for Golden Kamuy (theatrical preview arc “Sapporo Beer Factory Arc”) and as the anime’s opening theme.

With a strong international presence, ALI enjoys strong international popularity, having performed across the U.S., Argentina, Brazil, and successfully completed an Asia Tour in 2025. They appear at major festivals and perform live every year in multiple countries, energizing audiences worldwide. Their performances and cross-cultural sound continue to defy conventions, break barriers, and unite fans across the globe.
data.name: ALI

data.description:
BUMP OF CHICKEN is a four-piece Japanese rock band. Motoo Fujiwara (Vo./Gt.), Hiroaki Masukawa (Gt.), Yoshifumi Naoi (Ba.), and Hideo Masu (Dr.) Formed on February 11, 1996, the band rose to nationwide fame with their 2002 hit single “Tentai Kansoku.” Since then, they have provided theme songs for numerous anime, TV dramas, and films, earning broad acclaim as one of Japan’s most influential and enduring rock bands. Alongside their studio work, the band has remained highly active in live performances. In 2024, they held a large-scale arena and dome tour that attracted a total of 500,000 fans across Japan, reaffirming their strong presence in the country’s live music scene. Their success in both studio recordings and live performances has produced a wide range of acclaimed songs that connect deeply with listeners. Notable works include “ray,” a collaboration with Hatsune Miku; “Acacia,” the theme song for the Pokémon Special Music Video; “sailing day,” the theme song for One Piece: Dead End Adventure; “Chronostasis,” the theme for Detective Conan: The Bride of Halloween; “SOUVENIR,” the opening theme for the second cour of the hit anime SPY×FAMILY; “Sleep Walking Orchestra,” the opening theme for Delicious in Dungeon; and “Nanairo,” the theme for the NHK morning drama Okaeri Mone. NHK is Japan’s national public broadcaster, and their performance on the 72nd NHK Kōhaku Uta Gassen — Japan’s most prestigious annual music program — further solidified their cultural impact.
In 2024, the band released their 10th studio album, “Iris.” Their latest single “I,” released in October 2025, has been widely praised as the ending theme for My Hero Academia FINAL SEASON. As they approach their 30th anniversary in 2026, BUMP OF CHICKEN continues to be one of Japan’s most beloved and influential rock bands, inspiring fans of all ages across generations.
data.name: BUMP OF CHICKEN

Their music is a cathartic explosion of sound, both delicate and fast, progressive and full of color.

data.description:
hitorie started out as "Hitori-Atelier" which wowaka (vocal/guitar) formed with Igarashi (bass) and Yumao (drums) in 2011.  With the addition of Shinoda (guitar/chorus) in 2012, they became "hitorie" and a full-fledged band.  After playing live shows and making music for a while, they self-released a mini album in December that year entitled "Roomsick Girls Escape", followed by another self-release EP "non-fiction four e.p." in April 2013.  They performed a series of their first headlining shows entitled "hitori-escape" in April and May.  
On November 4, 2013, hitorie performed a headlining show entitled "hitori-escape: 11.4: Hinichijo Shibuya Edition", and announced that they would go major by launching "Hinichijo Records" under Sony Music.  
hitorie made their major debut with the single "Senseless Wonder" on January 22, 2014.  The song obtained the "power play" status at radio stations across Japan, and was chosen as the "heavy rotation" track on FM802.  They went on to release their first mini album "Imaginary Mono-Fiction" on February 19.  In April they went on a headlining tour entitled "Mannequin in the Park" and performed in Tokyo, Nagoya, and Osaka.  All venues including Ebisu Liquidroom (Tokyo) sold out.  They appeared in many rock festivals including "ROCK IN JAPAN FESTIVAL 2014", "WORLD HAPPINESS 2014", and "RISING SUN ROCK FESTIVAL 2014 in EZO" to name a few, reinforcing the fan base across Japan.  hitorie's first full-length album "WONDER and WONDER" was released on November 26.  In support, they went on a headlining tour entitled "WONDER and WANDER" performing in 12 cities between December 2014 and January 2015 and selling out Akasaka Blitz in Tokyo.
2015 saw the release of their second mini album "Monochrono Entrance" in July, and a sold-out headlining tour entitled "Talky Dance to Akai Kutsu" performing Club Quattro shows in Tokyo, Nagoya, and Osaka, and an additional show in Sendai.  In October, they launched "bAnd", a project to do two-band shows with artists they love and respect.  The first show took place at Shimokitazawa Garden with ZAZEN BOYS.  In November, they released their second single "Shutter Doll" and "Roomsick Girls Escape / non-fiction four e.p.".  The latter is the reissue of their two self-releases from their indie days combined.  "bAnd Vol. 2" was held at Shimokitazawa Garden again, this time with MO'SOME TONEBENDERS.
2016 began with the release of their third single "one-Me two-Hearts", the opening theme of the TV anime series "Divine Gate" in January, and second full-length album "DEEPER" on February 24.  They went on a tour starting from March entitled "one-Me Tour 'DEEP/SEEK'" and performed in 14 cities, culminating at Shin-Kiba Studio Coast in Tokyo on a high note.  In July, they held "bAND Vol. 3" at Shimokitazawa Garden with THE BACK HORN.  In September, the band launched another live event series entitled "nexUs", with each member curating artists whom he has connections with to share the bill.  The first event was held at Shimokitazawa Garden with Bed-In, curated by Shinoda.  Igarashi curated the second event in October at Daikanyama Unit, with Boku no Lyric no Boyomi.  The band closed the year with another full-length album "IKI", in December, and embarked on their biggest headlining tour ever, "2017 'IKI'", performing in 20 cities.
In 2017, wowaka participated in "HATSUNE MIKU 10th Anniversary Album 'Re:Start'" released on August 30.  He contributed "Unknown Mother Goose", his first vocaloid track in about six years.  The song was posted on Niconico and YouTube, instantly garnering one million views and creating buzz.  On September 11, "nexUs Vol. 3" was held at Ebisu Liquidroom, with Yumao bringing in Passepied.  On October 22, the hitorie version of "Unknown Mother Goose" was suddenly released digitally on various digital music and subscription services.  The song debuted at #1 on iTunes' rock chart on the same day.  Starting November 1, the band embarked on "HITORI-ESCAPE '2×3' TOUR", with a unique setting of playing two shows in three cities, namely Tokyo, Nagoya, and Osaka.  Day 1 was subtitled "omote" (front) and Day 2 "ura" (back) in each city.  They closed the year with the release of mini album "ai/SOlate" on December 6.  Its first-run only limited edition was a 2CD with a bonus live album of their tour final in 2016, which maximized the CD capacity of 80 minutes.
On January 17, 2018, "nexUs Vol. 4" took place at Akasaka Blitz, with UNISON SQUARE GARDEN brought by wowaka.  Ten days later, hitorie started their 10-city tour entitled "hitorie UNKNOWN-TOUR 2018 'Loveless'".  As additional dates, the band performed their first shows overseas in Taiwan and Shanghai, closing the tour with a blast.  They also went on "nexUs TOUR 2018" in July and their first international tour in October entitled "HITORI-ESCAPE in CHINA 'RED HOT POT TOUR'".  
hitorie released the album HOWLS on February 27, 2019, however, while on tour supporting the album, wowaka passed away in April.  He was remembered at a memorial concert entitled "wowaka Tsuito at Shin-Kiba Studio Coast" on June 1.  The band performed as a trio with Shinoda on vocals.   The trio resumed their live performing activities in September with a nationwide tour entitled "HITORI-ESCAPE TOUR 2019".
In August 2020, hitorie released "4", their first "best of" album that encapsulated the band's journey.  However, they were forced to cancel all 21 shows of the tour supporting the release, entitled "hitorie BEST ALBUM RELEASE TOUR '4'".  To make up for this, they performed a paid live streaming show entitled "hitorie BEST ALBUM RELEASE LIVE STREAMING '4'" in October.  On December 7, they released the digital single "curved edge", their first as a trio, and performed a live streaming concert on YouTube entitled "HITORI-ESCAPE 2020" to celebrate the new song.
hitorie celebrated their 7th anniversary on January 21 and 22, 2021, with two concerts at Ex Theater Roppongi, Tokyo, namely "HITORI-ATELIER LIVE Vol.2" and "HITORI-ESCAPE 2021: Cho Hinichijo Roppongi Nana Shunen Hen".  The shows were exclusively to "HITORI-ATELIER" (fan club) members.  They went on to release "REAMP", their first full-length album as a trio, on February 17.  Shinoda wrote lyrics to all songs and acted as the main composer of six songs.  Igarashi and Yumao also wrote two songs each, and the trio arranged all 10 songs together.  In April, they started a tour entitled "hitorie Amplified Tour 2021", performing in 10 cities and a total of 16 shows.  They also did the opening theme of the TV anime series "Eighty Six" which aired in April; the song "3-pun 29-byo (3 minutes and 29 seconds)" was released as a single on June 2.
hitorie released their first live album on January 19, 2022.  Entitled "Amplified Tour 2021 at OSAKA", it was a first-run-only bundle of two CDs and a T-shirt.  The album was followed by the release in the following week, of the digital single "Stereo Juvenile" on January 26.  Nationwide tour "HITORI-ESCAPE TOUR 2022" kicked off in February.  In April they contributed the closing theme of the TV anime series "Dance Dance Danseur", and the song "Kaze, Hana" was released as a single on May 25.  The following month, they released their new album "PHARMACY" on June 22.  In support of the album, they embarked on another nationwide tour entitled "hitorie Summer flight tour 2022" in June.

data.description: Ikimono Gakari, one of the most successful young pop/rock bands in Japan, actually claim to be not so young, citing 1999 as their formation date. However, their early attempt at rocking out didn't go anywhere. The group was established in Kanagawa by onetime schoolmates Mizuno Yoshiki and Yamashita Hotaka while they were attending separate colleges. The group expanded to a trio by the end of the year upon the addition of female underclassman Yoshioka Kiyoe as the vocalist. Right from the start the band was dubbed Ikimono Gakari -- a name that is as amusing in English as it is in Japanese, translating as "those in charge of the school pets." However, in 2000, after a year of spirited street performances, the bandmembers abandoned Ikimono Gakari in favor of their student careers and went to study in the university. That's a somewhat banal story; what's unusual here is that in 2002, after finishing their courses, they resurrected the project, and not just in the sense of a fun class reunion. The band was picked by independent label Thunder Snake, and by 2003 played sold-out local shows and released its first EP, Makoto ni Sen'etsu Nagara First Album wo Koshiraemashita, which translates as "Please excuse our impertinence, but we have crafted our first album."

He debuted in May 1996 as “T.M.Revolution,” which is his solo project, with the single “Dokusai -monopolize-“. His catchy songs, stage fascinating all audiences, the astounding live performance made him a star, and he made a smash hit in a row such as “HIGH PRESSURE,” “HOT LIMIT,” “WHITE BREATH,” “INVOKE.” 
He has started another music career with his own name “Takanori Nishikawa” since 2018. 
In 2021, T.M.Revolution celebrated their 25th anniversary since the debut and has been actively performing live, successfully completing a tour of all 47 prefectures in Japan.
In addition, he continues to take on various challenges such as acting, voice acting, and hosting TV shows.
He has been appointed as the first “Shiga Furusato Tourism Ambassador” and hosting his rock festival “Inazuma Rock Fes” every year at Shiga prefecture sponsored by the local government.
He was awarded “Shiga bunka koro sho (the Award for Cultural Distinguished Service by Shiga Prefecture” in 2020.
data.name: Takanori Nishikawa

In 2014 they released their 30th-anniversary album; in 2022, they went on their first tour in 7 years. 2023 marks their 40th anniversary since formation, and 2024 is their 40th debut anniversary year.

data.description:
Tomohisa Sako is a singer/songwriter born in Sapporo, Hokkaido, on December 26, 1991. Growing up in a snowy climate with few environments to perform on the streets, he shifted his base of musical activities in the Web world under the name "Shonen T". In the blink of an eye, he attracted raving comments such as "My ears are happy!", "T heals me through music!" which earned him the moniker of the "God of healing voice", making him the Prince Charming of the Web world.
 Sako made his debut with "Aikotoba" in March 2012. He celebrated the debut in a spectacular way, with a special event that brought 2,000 fans together to almost brim the place. The song peaked at #9 in the Oricon Daily chart. 
 Of the singles released since his debut, he has sent three singles to the Top 10 of Oricon's daily chart. 
 In 2013 he received an enthusiastic offer from the theater play "Tumbling Vol. 4"; he is also a flourishing actor.
data.name: Tomohisa Sako

data.description:
UVERworld is a Japanese rock band which was formed in 2000. 
This band currently consists six band members, with stage names of TAKUYA∞ (Lead vocal), Katsuya (Guitar), Akira (Guitar), Nobuto (Bass), Shintaro (Drums), and Seika (Sax & Manipulator). Having debuted under Sony Music Records with “D-tecnoLife” in 2005, they have released nine studio albums and over thirty singles, most of them being in the top 5 of the Japanese Oricon Charts. Their overseas popularity has grown but have not yet had an overseas gig (as of 2021). Despite that fact, they have sold over three million records worldwide. This comes from their many anime tie-ins such as "BLEACH", "Blue Exorcist", "GUNDAM", "My Hero Academia" etc.  The year 2020 marked their 20th anniversary year since formation.
data.name: UVERworld

24-year-old multi-artist who writes lyrics, composes, and arranges all by himself, as well as directs and self-produces designs and videos, he began posting songs on YouTube around spring 2019.

His new song “Homunculus” is also an anime tie-in for the much-anticipated anime, “My Hero Academia”.
Vaundy continues to capture the hearts and ears of his mostly teen fandom through his unique voice and genre-breaking style.

data.description:
X JAPAN has continued to influence the music scene over multiple generations with their magnificent stage presence and hardcore sound.
Their concerts are legendary, having filled the Tokyo Dome for all 18 of their shows there, for a total audience of a million people. Since reuniting in 2007, the band has toured around the world, including performances at New York's Madison Square Garden in 2014 and London's Wembley Arena in 2017. In 2018, they headlined Coachella, one of the world’s largest outdoor music festivals in the U.S., thrilling audiences worldwide. 
The live documentary film "We Are X" was released in theaters in more than 30 countries and has received critical acclaim, winning awards at the Sundance Film Festival and SXSW. 
Band members are YOSHIKI (leader, drums, piano), Toshl (vocals), PATA (guitar), SUGIZO (guitar), HIDE (guitar; died 1998), TAIJI (bass; died 2011), and HEATH (bass; died 2023).
data.name: X JAPAN

data.description:
Singer/songwriter Yui was handpicked to star in the movie "A Song to the Sun".  With her ample artistic talent, she attracts tremendous support mainly from her generation and as well as beyond.
In fall 2007 she performed at the traditionally milestone venue "Budokan" to a huge success.
In spring 2008, she released her third album "I LOVED YESTERDAY", followed by a massive nationwide tour performing 25 shows, all ending on a high note.
After a short hiatus in fall the same year, she released "MY SHORT STORIES", a collection of B-sides that had never made the studio album.  It debued at #1 on the Oricon chart and broke the record of B-side collections by a female for the first time in 25 years.
Single "to Mother", released in summer 2010, saw an impressive scene of her playing the piano, which created a buzz.
"HOLIDAYS IN THE SUN", her first album in 2 1/2 years, her nationwide tour, and a two-day return to the Budokan all turned out to be huge success.  
After releasing singles "It's My Life / Your Heaven" and "HELLO ~Paradise Kiss~" produced in Sweden, she went on to perform her first international show (Hong Kong / headlining / venue capacity 8,000).  The show was a success and catapulted her into a songbird of Asia.
Yui continues to attract attention with her distinctive presence and activities.
data.name: YUI

data.description: YUKI debuted in 1993 as the lead singer of the legendary band JUDY AND MARY. After the band broke up in 2001, she launched her solo career in February 2002 with the single "the end of shite." Her cutting-edge sound and avant-garde visuals established a distinctive worldview. In May 2012 when she performed at Tokyo Dome to celebrate her 10th anniversary as a solo artist and drew an audience of approx. 50,000, she became the first female singer in history to perform there as a band and a solo artist. By 2021 she had released ten studio albums, including five that topped the music charts. February 6, 2022, marked her 20th anniversary as a solo artist; she celebrated with the release of a new song and embarked on a nationwide tour. YUKI's one-of-a-kind song, expressions, and presence attract attention from various fields; she continues to be the one to keep your eyes on with her activities in music, live performances, and artworks.
data.name: YUKI

data.description:
millennium parade is a creative collective led by Tokyo-based producer/songwriter Daiki Tsuneta, who also leads one of the Japan’s biggest bands, King Gnu. They are an energetic group of artists from various creative fields, including music, film direction, visual effects, design & illustration. Their music is electronic-leaning, featuring synths & pop-inspired melodies, overlaying chaotic beats.

The group's collective vision strives to present Tokyo’s new values to the rest of the world. To surprise & awaken, globally. Emerging in 2019, with memorable music & companion videos (created by the band), their innovative launch party utilized 3D technology & live shows rapidly sold out. In 2020, ‘Fly with me’ was the main theme for world famous Japanese animation ‘Ghost In The Shell: SAC_2045’ & was remixed by Steve Aoki. The genre-bending ‘Philip’ followed, spinning tales of injustice & hope.

The mysterious group have already collaborated with DIOR & most recently adidas, for whom Tsuneta was named a Global Ambassador. Tsuneta has also featured in campaigns for Coach / Jean Michel Basquiat & more. The chaos continues with their debut album, now available.
